items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with a group coordinated by John Coltrane that included Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard, and uh, Elvin

ctx.x: When, when you, you say, he noticed you at a jam session at Birdland …
Uh-hm. That's what he told me and uh next thing I knew I was in his band, me and Tootie Heath. We replaced Flanagan and uh Elvin.
You know, what was, was there a given circle of musicians that were at Birdland during those sessions?
